s06_barrier_start.fix: Size anchor (CR-16): use the camera, ground plane and character sizes of the s05_paw_contact_end reference. Leo is as large there as here: his mane spans about x=0.38 to x=0.58 and y=0.30 to y=0.62 of the frame, his lying body reaches x=0.95; never smaller. Milo keeps his small same-depth size from that frame (ear tips to feet about 0.12 of the frame height). Leo is now awake in a low crouch at the same place, eyes open, one front paw beside the path; Milo stands on the path at x=0.52 in front of Leo's paw. Milo keeps the V4 canonical design: smooth rounded crown with no tuft, brown eyes, slim build, softly rounded cheeks, fine pale whiskers clearly visible on both sides of the muzzle, a subtle low-contrast central face seam. The pale-cream belly ends above the crotch and a clear taupe-grey gap separates his two slim legs down to both feet. Milo's face must match the canonical exactly: warm taupe-brown felt (not cool grey), large round dark-brown irises with cream sclera and small white highlights filling most of each eye, curved brown brows, a visible low-contrast central face seam from brow to nose, wide softly rounded cheeks, short cream muzzle with a tiny brown nose, fine pale whiskers on both sides. Use the V3 images only for staging, camera and the look of the net; Leo's identity comes from the V4 canonical (rust-orange mane, golden-ochre body, brown eyes, canonical face), never the V3 Leo colours. Leo's mane is the canonical burnt-orange rust colour, more orange than red (not red, not crimson), with the canonical large volume: long layered fuzzy wool locks framing the whole face and covering the upper chest, exactly like the V4 canonical image. Rope labels such as R01 or K-left are notes, never visible text.
